messages:
Anna (Product): Heads up — we need to lock constraints for the Private release next month. Focus: packaging, upgrade windows, and customer-managed networking. Need decisions on ownership & rollback.
Mike (Eng): What's hard constraint vs nice-to-have for MVP? We should be explicit.
Jess (Field Eng): Field signal: customers want zero-downtime upgrade and IP preservation for peering. Several ask to opt-out of auto-upgrade.
Ravi (NetOps): Auto-upgrade opt-out is fine but we lose ability to enforce SLOs. Propose two workflows: 'managed' (Redwood orchestrates) and 'handshake' (customer-led).
Anna (Product): Proposal: release shape = managed + operator-managed. For MVP we ship operator-managed with assisted scripts; managed comes later.
Olga (Customer Success): Must ship an operator checklist + rollback playbook. Customers expect clear rollback SLAs and comms.
Mike (Eng): Packaging plan: single tarball + manifest. Upgrades run via `redwood-upgrade` binary. Example flag: ```--handshake-mode=manual|auto```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: build 2023.10.2 — smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:
Jess (Field Eng): IP preservation notes: if customer uses hostNetwork we can preserve node IPs. In managed cloud installs IPs are ephemeral. Need docs for both.
Ravi (NetOps): Handshake protocol idea: customer provides `handshake-token`, ASN, and peering IP set. We'll validate CIDR overlap and ASN mismatch before upgrade.
Mike (Eng): Upgrade hook design: preflight -> snapshot KV/cache -> pause autoscaling -> upgrade -> run healthchecks -> if fail, auto-rollback to snapshot. Keep commands minimal.
Anna (Product): Decision: MVP includes snapshot/rollback + operator-managed handshake. Deferring full auto-upgrade orchestration to Q3.
Olga (Customer Success): Action: CS to draft rollback playbook, comm templates, and runbook for network owners. Need a concise one-pager for customers.
Jess (Field Eng): I'll recruit three pilot customers: ACME, CoPilot Labs, FinTrust. Will coordinate timelines.
Mike (Eng): Installer preflight checks to add: disk space, KMS key access, CIDR overlap test, `handshake-token` presence.
Anna (Product): Owners & targets: CS/Field -> 2026-04-10, Eng -> 2026-04-17, Docs -> 2026-04-20. Sound reasonable?
Ravi (NetOps): Note: legal needs to sign the peering/IP retention contract language. I'll escalate to legal and netops leadership.
Olga (Customer Success): @Anna +1. I'll start draft today.
Mike (Eng): Schema change: manifest add `upgrade.handoff.mode`, `upgrade.handoff.token_location`, `upgrade.handoff.preserve_ips` (boolean). Backwards compatible.
Anna (Product): Great. We'll freeze scope if no objections by EOD Friday. Sync cadence: weekly until pilot finishes. Thanks everyone.
